raw.rationale: The presence of CD138-positive and CD56-positive markers, along with EBV-positive status and gains of fluorescence signal at multiple loci, are characteristic of Extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma, which is consistent with the clinical presentation of a large polypoid mass obstructing the left nasal cavity.

rejected.label: Sinonasal natural killer cell lymphoma with CD138 expression
rejected.why: While CD138 expression is noted, the diagnosis is more accurately reflected by Extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma due to the comprehensive pathological and imaging findings.

rejected.label: Nasal-type T-cell lymphoma
rejected.why: The absence of CD20 and PAX5 expression, along with the presence of CD56, suggests a NK/T-cell origin rather than a pure T-cell lymphoma.

rejected.label: Sinonasal lymphoma with NK-cell markers
rejected.why: This option is less specific than Extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma, which better captures the NK/T-cell origin and EBV-positive status of the tumor.

rejected.label: Nasal lymphoma with NK-cell markers
rejected.why: Similar to Sinonasal lymphoma with NK-cell markers, this option is less specific and does not fully encapsulate the pathological characteristics of the tumor as well as Extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma does.

gold: Plasmablastic lymphoma (PBL), stage 1 with high-risk features
